title: A Former Teacher Wins a Big Senate Race in Texas
summary:
Democrat James Talarico has won a Senate race in Texas. He is the first Democrat to win a Senate seat in the state since 1988.

Talarico used to be a schoolteacher. He beat Republican Ken Paxton, and his win helped Democrats take control of Congress.

Many people did not know Talarico's name last year. In his campaign, he talked a lot about how expensive everyday life has become. Paxton said Talarico's ideas were too progressive for Texas.

The race was the most expensive Senate race in history. More than half a billion dollars was spent. Billionaire Elon Musk gave $158 million to a group that supported Paxton.

At a party in Austin, Talarico told his supporters, "We just proved that all the money in the world is no match for the people of Texas."

Texas is the second most populous state in the country, and Democrats had not won a race like this there for decades.
why_it_matters: The race shows that even a contest with record spending can be won by an ordinary person like a teacher — someone kids see every day.
